speaker: A
name: Alex
text: Do you like looking at yourself in the mirror? How often?

speaker: B
name: Mia
text: I wouldn't say I love doing it, because I'm not that handsome, honestly. But I do it often — maybe twice a day. Because when I go out, I need to check that I look fine, you know? It's not that I enjoy looking at myself — it's more like a necessity. I just need to make sure I look presentable.
